book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: HEBREOS SUK YACHACHIKUK RUNA KREYIKUK HEBREOMASINKUNATA KILLKARKAN

content: Tata Diospa wambran Jesukristu yachachiwanchisapa ima layami Tata Dioska nishpa.
Ñawpa tiempu kuti kuti Tata Dios alli yachachikuk runakunata rikchak layata yachachirkansapa. Chaymanta chay yachachikuk runakuna ñawpa awilunchikunata yachachirkansapa.

Kunan kay tukunan tiempu Tata Dios wambran Jesukristuta kachamurkan paypa rimananta yachachiwananchikunapa. Mana nima laya tiyaptinra Tata Dios wambranta willarkan tukuy laya tiyakta rurananpa. Chaymanta tukuy layata payta kurkan kamachikunanpa.

Jesukristu ñukanchikunata kawachiwanchisapa Tata Dios llipyak lusshina sukaman allima kananta. Payka Tatan Dios laya kashpa kawachiwanchisapa ima layami Tatanka nishpa. Sukaman alli yachak kashpa rimananllawan tukuy laya tiyakta kuydashpa sinchichiykan. Kay allpaman shamushpa wañurkan uchanchikunamanta perdonawashpa pichawananchikunapa. Chashna pichawashpanchikuna sielupi kawsak Tata Diospa alli ladunpi tiyarirkan paywan tantalla tukuy layata kamachikunanpa.
Tata Diospa wambranka tukuy angelkunamanta ashwan atipakmi ashwan sinchi kamachikukmi.
Chayrayku Jesukristu Tata Diospa wambran kashpa angelkunamanta ashwan sinchi kamachikukmi. Tata Dios paytaka willarkan angelkunamanta ashwan allima shutiyuk kananpa.

content.text: “Kanka wambraynimi kanki.
Kanta wañushkaykimanta kawsachimuptini tukuy layapi kamachikukmi kanki.”

content: Tata Dios mana niman suk angelta willarkanchu wambran kananta. Chaymanta Tata Dios chaylla wambranpa rimarkan:

content.text: “Ñukaka paypa tatanmi kani.
Payka ñukapa wambraynimi.”

content: Tata Dios manami niman suk angelta chashnachu willarkan.
Chaymanta Tata Dios chaylla wambranta kay allpaman kachamushpa tukuy angelkunata willarkan wambranta kuyanankunapa.
Chaymanta Tata Diospa ñawpa killkadunpi angelkunapa riman:

content.text: “Tata Dios angelkunata kachan wayrashina rawraykak ninashina tukuy mayta rinankunapa payta sirvik.”

content: Chaymanta Tata Dios killkadunpi wambranpa riman:

content.text: “Mana tukuyniyukta kanka sukaman kuskata allillata kamachikunki.
Kanka sukaman munanki allillata rurayta.
Mana niman suk mana allita munankichu rurayta.
Chayrayku ñuka Tata Diosniki kantaka akllashkayki kamachikunaykipa.
Tukuy kamachikukmasikikunamanta tukuy angelkunamanta kanta ashwanta kushichiyki.”
“Kallarinanmantapacha Señor,
kanmi allpata rurashpa sinchichishkanki.
Kanlla sielutapish rurashkanki.
Tukuy chay rurashkayki allpaka sieluka tukunan tiyan.
Chashna tukuptinpish mana tukuyniyukllata kanka kawsanki.
Allpawan sieluka llachapashina mawkayashpa usunka.
Chashna usuptin suk mawkayak llachapatashina wankunki.
Allpata mushukyachinki mushuk llachapata mudachikshina.
Allpa sielu tukuptinpish kanka chashnalla kanki.
Mana tukuyniyukta kawsanki.”
“Alli laduynipi shamuy tiyarik ñuka chiknishuknikikunata saru saru ruranaynikaman kanta allita kasushunankunapa.”

content: Tata Dios manami niman suk angelta chashnachu willarkan.
Angelkunata mana kawayta atipanchisapachu. Paykunaka Tata Diosta allita sirvishpa kawsansapa. Tata Dios paykunata kachamunsapa ñukanchikuna sieluman rik runakunata yanapawananchikunapa.
